success.description: You return life to the freshly-dead. Over about the next hour, all the target’s mortal wounds are healed (the target recovers critical and normal wounds until he has 1 fewer critical wound than his To and 1 fewer normal wound than his wound threshold) and he awakens to life.

chaosStar.description: For each critical wound the target recovers, suffer 1 critical wound. For each normal wound the target recovers, suffer 1 normal wound.

sigmarsComet.description: There’s no need to wait an hour; the target’s regeneration occurs almost instantaneously.

conservative.requirements: 12 power, engaged with target corpse of a living being killed within the last five minutes. Special: This spell begins recharging whether or not the attempt to cast it was successful. It recharges at dawn.
